result.title: FTFM: Factorized Tabular Foundation Models
result.summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are becoming a powerful alternative to conventional tabular learning, adapting to new datasets in context without task-specific training. Current architectures, however, face a trade-off: models that preserve cell-level representations are expensive because they repeatedly attend across rows and columns, while faster models collapse each row into a fixed embedding and lose this fine-grained state. We introduce Factorized Tabular Foundation Models (FTFM), which preserve cell representations while factorizing their computation through one contextual latent per row and one per column. Cells no longer attend to one another directly; instead, each cell is updated through the interaction of its row and column latents, reducing repeated attention while retaining feature-specific information. FTFM achieves competitive predictive performance in tabular classification on major benchmarks such as TabArena and BeyondArena.

AI.brief_summary: FTFM 为表格基础模型提出因式化计算：用每行、每列各一个 contextual latent 交互更新 cell 表示，在不做逐 cell 直接注意力的前提下保留 cell 级状态，并在 TabArena、BeyondArena 等基准上取得有竞争力的分类性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「保留 cell 级表示还是坍缩为行级固定嵌入」的取舍与 LVR 关注的信息坍缩、细粒度视觉证据保留问题相似，行列因式化 latent 或可作为减少 latent 间重复注意力同时保住细粒度状态的类比线索，可供核查。
